author: Maergoth
name: ReverbRaid
short: Plan EverQuest II raids with interactive Discord signups.
description: Create EQ2 raid events through a private DM wizard, collect all 26 class signups with attending, tentative, late, bench, and absent statuses, manage events through Discord components, and export rosters as CSV. Persistent views continue working after Red restarts.
install_msg: Reverb Raid is installed. Run `[p]load reverbraid`, then use `/raid gettingstarted` for the skippable walkthrough or `/raid setup` for the full dashboard. Use `Sync EQ2 icons` once as the Red bot owner. To expose `/create` and `/raid`, run `[p]slash enablecog reverbraid` followed by `[p]slash sync`. The cog name is case-sensitive.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, display names, raid signup classes, availability statuses, and optional signup notes. Archived rosters are retained until an organizer permanently deletes the event or the data is deleted through Red's data-deletion system.
